messages:
maria gonzalez: Pager fired — large spike in 5xx on api-frontend.prod. Started ~10:48 UTC. Dashboard shows ~6% 5xx vs baseline ~0.5%. Getting user reports.
incident-bot: [ALERT] api_frontend_errors_total rate(1m) > 3% — fired — https://grafana.redwood/alerts/12345
alex chen: oncall here, ack. pulling logs/dash now. any recent deploys or config changes?
maria gonzalez: canary routing change at ~10:30 by @liz_k (20% rollout). stack traces show grpc/proto mismatch from upstream adapter. could be related.
liz_k: that's me — I pushed the routing tweak. rolling back the canary now.
deploy-bot: rollback started for rollout/route-2026-03-15 by liz_k — status: in_progress
alex chen: also scaling api-frontend +2 replicas and triggering cache flush to evict bad KV state. running: ``kubectl scale deploy api-frontend --replicas=6`` && ``curl -X POST https://internal-cache/flush``
maria gonzalez: customer impact: 3 paying customers affected (ACME, BetaHealth, dev-qa). symptoms: webhook POST failures and slow chat completions. peak error rate ~12% for ~4m in us-west. SLO burn visible.
paul_customer_ops: ACME opened an escalation ticket, pinged their SRE. I told them we're rolling back and will follow up.
deploy-bot: rollback completed — rollout/route-2026-03-15 -> succeeded. traffic back to baseline for routing.
alex chen: errors dropping to baseline over the last 6m. services appear stable. setting incident -> mitigated.
incident-bot: Incident mitigated by alex chen at 10:58 UTC. Duration: ~10m.
alex chen: quick post-incident notes (live): - root cause likely canary routing mismatch + KV cache stale state. - mitigation: rollback + scale + cache flush. - customer comms in progress.
maria gonzalez: big picture: alert config flapped us into immediate paging. we need better thresholds and canary-aware filters. also want a dashboard for retros that shows golden signals and drilldowns per-route/customer.
nashwin patel: typo — it's ashwin :) I'll take the dashboard. Plan: create "Incident Retrospective — api-frontend" dashboard in Grafana with focused panels and drilldowns.
nashwin patel: Proposed panels (short): - 99th pct latency by route - 5xx rate (region + route) - request rate by model/route - kv cache hit ratio - backend queue length / processing time - error budget burn rate - top failing request samples (link to logs) - recent deploys / rollout percent timeline
maria gonzalez: add a panel for "per-customer failing requests" (sampled, not full logs) so SREs can quickly see which customers are impacted. also add a small table with recent escalations/tickets.
nashwin patel: putting in some rough PromQLs (to iterate on):
```
# 5xx rate (percentage, 5m window)
(sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="api-frontend", status=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="api-frontend"}[5m]))) * 100

# 99th latency by route (5m)
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="api-frontend"}[5m])) by (le, route))

# error budget burn (1h window)
( increase(slo_errors_total{service="api-frontend"}[1h]) / increase(slo_window_total{service="api-frontend"}[1h]) ) * 100
```
liz_k: for alerts, recommendation: change the prometheus rule to use a 5m evaluation window (was 1m), and require sustained >4% 5xx for 5m to fire. also add `route` label so canaries don't trigger prod-wide alerts.
alex chen: agree. action items: 1) ashwin -> dashboard PR + panel JSON, 2) liz_k -> prometheus alert rule change + test in staging, 3) maria -> customer comms summary and retro writeup, 4) alex -> postmortem + timeline.
maria gonzalez: also consider lowering sensitivity for canary routing metrics (only alert when rollout > 50% or when route=prod).
paul_customer_ops: timeline note: told ACME we mitigated at 10:58 UTC, they'll wait for root-cause explanation; I'll attach incident link.
nashwin patel: I'll open the Grafana PR today and link it here. draft name: `dashboards/incident-retro-api-frontend.json`. I'll include panel links and drilldown macros to per-region dashboards.
alex chen: retro meeting proposed tomorrow 11:00am UTC — quick 30m to go over timeline and dashboard. invite sent to eng-sre, eng-runtime, customer-ops.
maria gonzalez: post-incident followups: - change alert window to 5m and threshold to 4% (liz) - add `route` label to metrics and filter canary (liz) - dashboard PR (ashwin) - postmortem + timeline (alex) - customer comms (maria/paul)
liz_k: I'll prepare the alert change and a test plan in staging. will reference the PromQL ashwin posted.
nashwin patel: PR opened: https://git.redwood/dashboards/pulls/42 — includes initial JSON + panel queries. please review.
maria gonzalez: thanks everyone. please add any additional metrics you want on the dashboard (kv eviction rate, model-queue-depth). we'll include them in the PR. :thumbsup:
alex chen: closing the thread — incident mitigated; follow-ups assigned. posting a short summary to #incidents/doc after retro.
incident-bot: Reminder: create incident postmortem doc within 48h — use template: https://docs.redwood/incidents/template
paul_customer_ops: adding a quick note to ACME ticket with rollback time and next steps.
